property_summary: For every call to C's fallback, if the sent msg.value is not exactly 10 ether then the reference contract must reject (revert) and thus not update pastBlockTime nor change address(c).balance; the mutant changing the required amount to 1 ether allows some calls (msg.value == 1 ether) that the reference rejects, causing state/balance changes and thus differing observable behavior.
change_summary: Change the requirement amount from 10 ether to 1 ether, altering which calls pass the value check and thus when pastBlockTime and transfers occur.
